services.name: Tula Paddle Sports Summer Adventure Camp
services.desc: Duration 5 weeks The camp runs for five weeks (June 17th-20th, June 24th-27th, July 8th-11th, July 22nd-25th and August 5th-9th) Monday through Thursday, from 9:00AM to 1:00PM. About 1) Kayaking and Paddle Boarding: Campers will learn the fundamentals of kayaking and paddle boarding from certified instructors. They will embark on guided excursions around Little Creek and the Chesapeake Bay, discovering wildlife and serene waters. 2) Beach Activities: From beach games to sandcastle building contests, campers will enjoy a variety of lively games under the sun.
